questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: Two parallel infinite line charges with linear charge densities +λ and -λ are placed at a distance of 2R in free space. What is the electric field midway between the two line charges?
questions.explanation: Electric field due to +λ at midpoint (distance R) is E₁ = λ/(2πε₀R) towards -λ. Field due to -λ is E₂ = λ/(2πε₀R) towards -λ (attractive). Total E = E₁ + E₂ = 2 * (λ/(2πε₀R)) = λ/(πε₀R).
questions.imagePrompt: Clean physics diagram. Two vertical infinite lines shown. Left line labeled +λ, right line labeled -λ. Distance between them marked as 2R. A point P is midway (distance R from each). Electric field vectors E₁ and E₂ from both charges pointing in the same direction (towards right). Net electric field vector E_net shown. Professional electrostatic field diagram.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: The time period of a simple pendulum measured inside a stationary lift is T. If the lift starts accelerating upwards with an acceleration g/3, the new time period will be:
questions.explanation: T = 2π√(L/g). When accelerating up, g_eff = g + a = g + g/3 = 4g/3. T' = 2π√(L/g_eff) = 2π√(L/(4g/3)) = (√3/2) * 2π√(L/g) = (√3/2)T.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: In a Young's double slit experiment, the fringe width is found to be 0.4 mm. If the whole apparatus is immersed in water of refractive index 4/3, without disturbing the geometrical arrangement, the new fringe width will be:
questions.explanation: Fringe width β = λD/d. In medium, λ' = λ/μ. New width β' = λ'D/d = (λ/μ)D/d = β/μ. β' = 0.4 / (4/3) = 0.3 mm.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Which of the following molecules has a T-shaped geometry?
questions.explanation: ClF₃ has 7 valence electrons. 3 bond pairs with F, 2 lone pairs. Steric number = 3+2 = 5 (Trigonal bipyramidal). Lone pairs occupy equatorial positions to minimize repulsion, resulting in a T-shaped geometry.
questions.imagePrompt: Clean chemistry molecular geometry diagram. Shows Chlorine (Cl) central atom bonded to three Fluorine (F) atoms. Two lone pairs shown on Cl in the equatorial plane of a trigonal bipyramid. The F-Cl-F bond angles shown less than 90 degrees due to lone pair repulsion. Distinct T-shape structure. 3D ball and stick model style.

questions.question: For a first order reaction, the half-life period is independent of:
questions.explanation: For first order reaction, t½ = 0.693 / k. It does not contain the initial concentration term [A]₀.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Which one of the following is an example of a thermosetting polymer?
questions.explanation: Bakelite (Phenol-Formaldehyde resin) is a cross-linked thermosetting polymer that cannot be remoulded upon heating.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: The correct order of acidity for the following compounds is:
questions.explanation: Phenol is more acidic due to resonance stabilization of phenoxide ion. Water is more acidic than ethanol because the ethyl group is electron donating which destabilizes the ethoxide ion. Order: Phenol > Water > Ethanol.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: The area bounded by the curve y = |x - 1| and y = 1 is:
questions.explanation: Curve y = |x-1| is V-shaped with vertex at (1,0). Line y=1 intersects it at x=0 and x=2. Area is a triangle with base length 2 (from x=0 to x=2) and height 1. Area = 1/2 * base * height = 1/2 * 2 * 1 = 1.
questions.imagePrompt: Clean math graph on white. Coordinate axes. Graph of y = |x - 1| (V-shape touching x-axis at 1). Horizontal line y = 1. Intersection points (0,1) and (2,1) marked. Shaded triangular region between the V-curve and the line y=1. Area labeled. Professional calculus diagram.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: If A is a square matrix of order 3 such that |A| = 2, then |adj A| is equal to:
questions.explanation: Formula: |adj A| = |A|^(n-1). Here n=3, |A|=2. So |adj A| = 2^(3-1) = 2² = 4.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: The derivative of sin⁻¹(2x√(1-x²)) with respect to sin⁻¹x, for -1/√2 < x < 1/√2, is:
questions.explanation: Let y = sin⁻¹(2x√(1-x²)). Put x = sinθ. y = sin⁻¹(sin 2θ) = 2θ = 2sin⁻¹x. Let z = sin⁻¹x. We need dy/dz = d(2z)/dz = 2.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: Three numbers are chosen from 1 to 30. The probability that they are not consecutive is:
questions.explanation: Total ways = ³⁰C₃. Consecutive triples: (1,2,3), (2,3,4)...(28,29,30) = 28 ways. P(consecutive) = 28 / ³⁰C₃. ³⁰C₃ = (30*29*28)/6 = 4060. P(consecutive) = 28/4060 = 1/145. P(not consecutive) = 1 - 1/145 = 144/145.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: Which of the following structures is homologous to the wing of a bird?
questions.explanation: Bird wings and whale flippers are forelimbs modified for different functions but share the same fundamental bone structure (humerus, radius, ulna, etc.), making them homologous organs showing divergent evolution.
questions.imagePrompt: Clean biology diagram showing comparative anatomy. Side-by-side skeletal structure of a bird wing and a whale flipper. Similar bones (humerus, radius, ulna, carpals, phalanges) color-coded to show homology. Labels indicating homologous structures. Professional evolutionary biology diagram.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: Myelin sheath is produced by:
questions.explanation: Myelin sheath is produced by Schwann cells in the PNS and Oligodendrocytes in the CNS.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: Which hormone causes dilation of blood vessels, increased oxygen consumption and glucogenesis?
questions.explanation: Adrenaline (Epinephrine) is the 'fight or flight' hormone that increases heart rate, dilates blood vessels to muscles, and increases blood glucose levels.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: Double fertilization is exhibited by:
questions.explanation: Double fertilization is a unique characteristic of Angiosperms involving syngamy (one male gamete + egg) and triple fusion (one male gamete + two polar nuclei).
